scientific_integrity: Exact infinite switching identity proved by inclusion-exclusion and a cycle matching-polynomial identity; code corroboration is finite. Full automorphism classification is attributed to the cited primary literature.
scientific_limitations: No general classification of all common-neighbour coincidences, no all-rank three-round upper bound, and no independent publication-priority verification. The finite census through size twenty-five is not a proof of uniqueness at arbitrary size.
title: A cycle-splitting common-neighbour law for matching derangement graphs
